purpose.microphone: Autoradio hears you when Voice is on, so you can talk to the radio, and records your voice when you tap Take. Speech becomes text on this phone. A take is uploaded only if you publish it.
purpose.speech: Autoradio turns what you say into text on this phone, to understand your request.
onboarding.askSignIn.title: Sign in to ask the radio
onboarding.askSignIn.why: Listening needs no account; asking does, so the radio has a computer of yours to keep your questions on.
